item.title: Introvert Snail Cancelled Plans Best Day Ever
item.description: A happy little snail peeks out of its shell holding a tiny phone, relieved that the plans got cancelled and calling it the best day ever. Perfect for introverts and homebodies, it makes a funny gift on stickers, mugs and hoodies. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Anxious Axolotl Smiling Through the Overthinking
item.description: A pink axolotl wears a wobbly smile while clutching a tangled ball of string, smiling through the overthinking like a pro. A funny gift for anxious friends, chronic overthinkers and axolotl lovers. Available on stickers, mugs and hoodies. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Introvert Snail Social Battery Charging Slowly
item.description: A tiny snail tucked into its shell with a battery charm, slowly recharging after too much socializing. A funny gift for introverts and homebodies who need quiet time. Comes on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Drained Possum Social Battery Empty Playing Dead
item.description: A worn-out possum lies flat on its back clutching a tiny empty battery, because when your social battery hits zero, playing dead is the only option. A funny gift for introverts and burned-out friends, on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Shy Introvert Snail Booked Solid in My Shell
item.description: A shy snail peeks out of its shell with one eye, fully booked with plans to stay home and do nothing at all. Perfect for introverts and homebodies, it makes a funny gift on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Anxiety Frog Lit a Candle Still Anxious
item.description: A round little frog nervously clutching a lit candle, because self-care doesn't always fix everything. A cute, witchy gift for anyone whose anxiety stays lit too. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Introvert Ghost - Ghosting Everyone, Nothing Personal
item.description: A shy little ghost peeks over its shoulder while quietly ghosting everyone, nothing personal. Perfect for introverts, homebodies and anyone whose social battery is always on low. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Introvert Bat - Staying In, Lights Off, Thanks
item.description: A tiny bat hangs upside down, wrapped in its wings like a cozy blanket, with no plans to go out. Perfect for homebodies, introverts and anyone who loves a cute spooky bat. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Introvert Ghost Sticker - Socially Transparent Cute Ghost
item.description: A shy little ghost holding a tiny candle, just hoping nobody notices. Perfect for introverts who'd rather stay invisible at every social gathering. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
